qisqacha.uz: Kontaktor, Start/Stop tugmalari va o‘zini ushlab turish kontakti — asosiy motor sxemasi.
qisqacha.ru: Контактор, кнопки Пуск/Стоп и самоподхват — базовая схема двигателя.
qisqacha.en: Contactor, Start/Stop buttons and a holding contact — the basic motor circuit.

topshiriq.uz: Uch fazali motorni avtomat QF1 va kontaktor KM1 orqali ulang. Boshqaruv: L1 faza → Stop (SB1, NC) → Start (SB2, NO) → KM1 g‘altagi → N. Start tugmasiga parallel KM1 ning NO 13–14 kontaktini ulang (o‘zini ushlab turish).
topshiriq.ru: Подключите трёхфазный двигатель через автомат QF1 и контактор KM1. Управление: фаза L1 → Стоп (SB1, НЗ) → Пуск (SB2, НО) → катушка KM1 → N. Параллельно кнопке Пуск подключите контакт KM1 NO 13–14 (самоподхват).
topshiriq.en: Connect the three-phase motor through breaker QF1 and contactor KM1. Control: phase L1 → Stop (SB1, NC) → Start (SB2, NO) → KM1 coil → N. Put KM1 contact NO 13–14 in parallel with Start (holding contact).

uz: Kuch zanjiri: VVOD → QF1 (L1-L2-L3) → QF1 (T1-T2-T3) → KM1 (L1-L2-L3) → KM1 (T1-T2-T3) → motor U, V, W.
Boshqaruv fazasi QF1.T1(2) dan olinadi: QF1.T1(2) → SB1.11; SB1.12 → SB2.23.
SB2.24 → KM1.A1; KM1.A2 → N. KM1.NO(13) ni SB2.23 ga, KM1.NO(14) ni SB2.24 ga ulang — o‘zini ushlab turish.
ru: Силовая цепь: VVOD → QF1 (L1-L2-L3) → QF1 (T1-T2-T3) → KM1 (L1-L2-L3) → KM1 (T1-T2-T3) → U, V, W двигателя.
Фаза управления — с QF1.T1(2): QF1.T1(2) → SB1.11; SB1.12 → SB2.23.
SB2.24 → KM1.A1; KM1.A2 → N. KM1.NO(13) к SB2.23, KM1.NO(14) к SB2.24 — самоподхват.
en: Power: VVOD → QF1 (L1-L2-L3) → QF1 (T1-T2-T3) → KM1 (L1-L2-L3) → KM1 (T1-T2-T3) → motor U, V, W.
Control phase from QF1.T1(2): QF1.T1(2) → SB1.11; SB1.12 → SB2.23.
SB2.24 → KM1.A1; KM1.A2 → N. KM1.NO(13) to SB2.23, KM1.NO(14) to SB2.24 — holding contact.
